description: Collect public Snapchat Spotlight videos by hashtag, tag/topic URL, or Spotlight video URL, or page through the anonymous Spotlight feed. No login, cookies, or proxy required.

enrichDetails.description: Batch-fetch Snapchat's public video details endpoint to fill unwatermarked MP4 URLs, hashtags, AI metadata, duration, and exact engagement counts. Adds one request per 30 videos.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich with video details

feedPages.description: How many pages of the Spotlight up-next feed to request in Paginated Spotlight feed mode. Each page adds about 20-23 videos; pagination stops early when Snapchat runs out.
feedPages.title: Feed pages

hashtags.description: Used in Hashtag or topic videos mode. Bare words (food), hash-prefixed tags (#travel), path forms (/tag/food, /topic/cappuccino-foam-technique), or full Snapchat URLs (https://www.snapchat.com/tag/food, https://www.snapchat.com/topic/cappuccino-foam-technique).
hashtags.sectionDescription: Each hashtag is read from its tag page and Explore results, then combined and deduplicated.
hashtags.title: Hashtags, topics, or URLs

includeHashtagMetadata.description: Include hashtag identity fields (id, name, URL, source, description, and total video count when Snapchat exposes it) in every record.
includeHashtagMetadata.title: Include hashtag metadata

includeLlmMetadata.description: Include Snapchat's AI-generated title, description, and keywords when present.
includeLlmMetadata.title: Include AI metadata

includeRelatedTopics.description: Include related topics, related hashtags, and scene-to-interest (S2I) content tags when the page provides them.
includeRelatedTopics.title: Include related topics and tags

includeVideoUrls.description: Include the watermarked and unwatermarked MP4 CDN URLs. These URLs carry expiring Snapchat tokens, so download or re-host media soon after scraping.
includeVideoUrls.title: Include video URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the total number of video rows saved across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

minLikes.description: Keep only videos with at least this many likes. Use 0 to keep everything.
minLikes.title: Minimum likes

minViews.description: Keep only videos with at least this many views. Use 0 to keep everything.
minViews.title: Minimum views

mode.description: Choose what to collect: videos for hashtags/topics, a paginated Spotlight feed, or specific Spotlight URLs.
mode.title: Mode

resultsPerHashtag.description: Maximum videos to keep for each hashtag after combining the tag/topic page with Explore results. Snapchat serves about 32 videos per tag page plus about 20-25 Explore cards.
resultsPerHashtag.title: Max videos per hashtag

sinceDate.description: Keep only videos uploaded on or after this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD (for example 2026-01-01). Leave empty to keep all dates.
sinceDate.title: Uploaded since

sortBy.description: Order within each hashtag/topic group. Hashtags stay in the order you enter them; feed mode sorts the whole feed. Source order keeps Snapchat's own ranking.
sortBy.title: Sort by

spotlightUrls.description: Used in Specific Spotlight URLs mode, or as the optional first seed in Paginated Spotlight feed mode. Accepts full Spotlight links (https://www.snapchat.com/@user/spotlight/ID), /spotlight/ID links, or raw IDs.
spotlightUrls.sectionDescription: Paste one or more public Spotlight video links or IDs.
spotlightUrls.title: Spotlight URLs or IDs

title: Snapchat Hashtag Scraper Input
